_comment: In-app download catalog (P2). Copy of tools/ai-pack.models.json: same URL, path, size and sha256
for every component (AiPackCatalogTests.MatchesTheToolsCatalog fails when they diverge).
The language model is the whole Qwen3-4B Q4_K_M file: the in-app download has no 2 GiB asset cap.
Sizes and hashes come from the Hugging Face API (lfs.size / lfs.oid) at the pinned revision.
